name: @amical/stt-helper
description: Qwen3-ASR (MLX) speech-to-text helper for macOS (Apple Silicon)

scripts.build:native: mkdir -p .build && swift build --configuration release && mkdir -p bin && cp .build/release/stt-helper bin/stt-helper && cp -R vendor/mlx-swift_Cmlx.bundle bin/mlx-swift_Cmlx.bundle
